name: First Principles
description: Strip away assumptions and rebuild from fundamental truths.

name: 5 Whys
description: Ask why repeatedly to drill from a symptom down to the root cause.

name: Socratic Questioning
description: Targeted questions that surface hidden assumptions and guide discovery.

name: Second-Order Thinking
description: Trace cascading downstream effects beyond the immediate outcome.

name: Inversion
description: Ask what would guarantee failure to reveal obstacles and blind spots.

name: Problem Decomposition
description: Split a tangled problem into independent sub-problems and reassemble.

name: Steelmanning
description: Build the strongest form of the opposing view before responding.
output_pattern: opposing view → strongest form → honest rebuttal

name: Abstraction Laddering
description: Move up (why) for strategy or down (how) for tactics to solve at the right altitude.

name: Reframe the Question
description: Challenge whether the stated problem is the real problem.

name: Stakeholder Lens Rotation
description: Adopt each stakeholder world-view in turn to find overlooked needs.
output_pattern: perspective A → B → C → gaps found

name: Map Is Not the Territory
description: Treat any model as lossy and check where it diverges from reality.

name: Pre-mortem
description: Imagine the launch has already failed, then work back to the causes.

name: Failure Mode Analysis
description: Enumerate how each component could fail and guard each mode.

name: Assumption Audit
description: List every assumption, rate by confidence and impact, stress-test the weakest.

name: Identify Potential Risks
description: Brainstorm what could go wrong across every category.

name: Challenge from Critical Perspective
description: Play devil's advocate to stress-test an idea against groupthink.

name: SCAMPER
description: Apply seven lenses: substitute, combine, adapt, modify, put, eliminate, reverse.
output_pattern: S → C → A → M → P → E → R

name: Reverse Engineering
description: Work backwards from the desired outcome to the implementation path.
output_pattern: end state → steps backward → path forward

name: What If Scenarios
description: Explore alternative realities to surface possibilities and implications.

name: Constraint Injection
description: Add an artificial limitation to force novel solutions.

name: Subtraction
description: Improve by deliberately removing elements instead of adding them.
output_pattern: current state → what to remove → simplified result

name: Stakeholder Round Table
description: Convene personas with competing interests to find a balanced solution.

name: Six Thinking Hats
description: Rotate six modes: facts, feelings, caution, optimism, creativity, process.
output_pattern: white → red → black → yellow → green → blue

name: Expert Panel Review
description: Assemble domain experts for deep specialised review.

name: Delphi Method
description: Collect independent estimates, reveal, revise, converge without anchoring.

name: Architecture Decision Records
description: Propose and debate architectural options with explicit trade-offs.

name: Boundary & Edge Case Sweep
description: Test the extremes: zeros, nulls, maximums, and type mismatches.
output_pattern: inputs → boundaries → edge cases → failures found

name: Red Team vs Blue Team
description: Adversarial attack-defend pass to find and harden vulnerabilities.

name: Source Triangulation
description: Require three independent source types before accepting a claim.
output_pattern: claim → source A → B → C → confidence

name: Occam's Razor
description: Find the simplest sufficient explanation and cut needless complexity.
